scope: Independent OpenKatana plugin, responsive layout and shaped text implementation

checks.name: actual plugin discovery and parameter schemas
grid and intrinsic layout at 640x360; no content overflow
Arabic RTL, Indic conjunct and combining-mark grapheme ranges
actual contextual joins and OpenType ligature metrics
variable font width axis changes real layout metrics
reveal retains full shaped run and stable cluster geometry
responsive portrait reflow at 360x640 without scaled-down text
larger viewport recomputes layout and clamped font sizes
vertical writing uses actual top-to-bottom glyph placement
emoji ZWJ grapheme segmentation (not bundled emoji-font rendering)
plugin effect mount/dispose lifecycle across viewport and document changes
custom operator produces validated proposal without mutating input
batch add/replace/remove/copy/move/test transaction
failed batch leaves caller document unchanged
unsupported operator parameter rejected
post-operation invalid document rejected
unsupported CSS value rejected by browser
off-origin plugin request blocked
plugin effects + RTL reveal render, backwards seek, remount and exact video frames
same composition renders portrait with responsive layout
stateful visual plugin fails deterministic render
composition clip and native operator proposal work in existing timeline renderer

distribution.environment: Windows; separate application install using existing local Python dependencies, Chrome and FFmpeg. Not a fresh OS or cross-platform qualification.

provenance.new_assets: Unmodified Noto Sans Arabic 2.012 and Noto Sans Devanagari 2.007, OFL-1.1, pinned Google Fonts commit 47d54ca1ebb14fd864695f1d39dc734f39017c33

limits: No hosted comparison in this task
No private native plugin binary ABI or command-syntax compatibility
Arbitrary script/font combinations and malicious plugin isolation not established
Browser-version and font coverage affect output
